chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The divorce of a young boy is valid when he reaches ten years of age.
ai.seo_question: At what age is a young boy's divorce considered valid in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a pre-pubescent male's (sabi) divorce is valid upon reaching ten years, reflecting the Shia juristic view that this age marks the threshold of discernment (tamyiz) for marital contracts. It highlights the practical application of puberty signs in personal status law, distinguishing it from the majority Sunni view which often ties validity more strictly to physical maturity or specific contractual conditions.
